title: Frigg Credentials API Schemas
description: JSON schemas for credentials API requests and responses

credential.description: A credential object representing authentication data for an external system. Tokens are masked in responses.

externalId.description: ID from the external system (e.g., account ID, organization ID)

userId.description: ID of the user who owns this credential

authIsValid.description: Whether the authentication is currently valid

entityCount.description: Number of entities using this credential

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the credential was created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the credential was last updated

listCredentialsResponse.description: Response from GET /api/v2/credentials - returns list of credentials for the authenticated user

getCredentialResponse.description: Response from GET /api/v2/credentials/:credentialId - returns a single credential

deleteCredentialResponse.description: Legacy delete result. DELETE /api/v2/credentials/:credentialId answers 204 No Content.

reauthorizeCredentialRequest.description: Request to POST /api/v2/credentials/:credentialId/reauthorize - refresh or update credential authentication

data.description: Authentication data (OAuth code, API keys, form fields, etc.)

step.description: Current step number for multi-step reauthorization flows

sessionId.description: Session ID from previous step (required for step > 1)

reauthorizeCredentialNextStep.description: Next step in multi-step reauthorization flow

totalSteps.description: Total number of steps in the flow

sessionId.description: Session ID to use for the next step

requirements.description: Requirements for the next step (form fields, OAuth URL, etc.)

message.description: Message to display to user (e.g., 'OTP sent to your email')
